---
title: "04_Seurat_Preparation"
subtitle: "Seurat objects for all AOIs and for PanCK+ AOIs (scaling, PCA, neighbours, UMAP)"
author: "Luca Mastrantoni"
output: html_document
---

Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03)  
Output: `OUTPUT/rds/demoSeurat.rds`, `OUTPUT/rds/PanCK_seurat.rds`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))

counts <- assay(spe_ruv, "counts")
logcounts <- assay(spe_ruv, "logcounts")
metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_ruv))

# Seurat replaces underscores in feature names with dashes: do it here so names match
rownames(counts) <- gsub("_", "-", rownames(counts))
rownames(logcounts) <- gsub("_", "-", rownames(logcounts))

# The data are already normalised (TMM + RUV4 logCPM), so no Seurat normalisation
demoSeurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = metadata)
demoSeurat <- SetAssayData(demoSeurat, layer = "data", new.data = logcounts)
demoSeurat
```

##### All AOIs (scaled data used for the correlation heatmap in 08)
```{r}
demoSeurat <- FindVariableFeatures(demoSeurat)
demoSeurat <- ScaleData(demoSeurat)
demoSeurat <- RunPCA(demoSeurat, verbose = FALSE)
demoSeurat <- FindNeighbors(demoSeurat, reduction = "pca", dims = seq_len(30))
# NB: PanCK_seurat below inherits this all-AOI clustering (RNA_snn_res.0.8);
# 09_PanCK_Clustering removes it before clustering the PanCK+ AOIs.
demoSeurat <- FindClusters(demoSeurat, verbose = FALSE)
saveRDS(demoSeurat, file = file.path(path_rds, "demoSeurat.rds"))
```

##### PanCK+ AOIs
```{r}
PanCK_seurat <- subset(demoSeurat, subset = Segment == "PanCK")
PanCK_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(PanCK_seurat)
PanCK_seurat <- ScaleData(PanCK_seurat)
PanCK_seurat <- RunPCA(PanCK_seurat, verbose = FALSE)
PanCK_seurat <- FindNeighbors(PanCK_seurat, dims = 1:20)
PanCK_seurat <- RunUMAP(PanCK_seurat, dims = 1:20)

DimPlot(PanCK_seurat, reduction = "umap", group.by = "Category")
saveRDS(PanCK_seurat, file = file.path(path_rds, "PanCK_seurat.rds"))
```
